name: Cafe Bar Restaurante Alfredo
title: Cafe Bar Restaurante Alfredo
paragraphs: Established by Chef Alfredo and Ivana, cooking and serving since 1987.

Welcome to Alfredo, where decades of culinary expertise meet a passion for authentic flavors. Since 1987, Chef Alfredo has dedicated himself to crafting dishes that showcase the very best of Mediterranean cuisine, complemented by select international offerings.

We pride ourselves on using only the finest ingredients. Whether you’re exploring the rich flavors of Mediterranean dishes, from land to sea, or enjoying international cuisine, we are committed to delivering a genuine, high-quality experience.

As a family-run business, we are deeply committed to your satisfaction, both in the kitchen and at your table. Chef Alfredo personally oversees the kitchen, while Ivana leads our attentive service team.
We speak Italian, Spanish, English, German, and Croatian to make you feel at home, no matter where you’re from.
